_about: Every gate a command can require, named by what it means. DECISIONS ('gates') are Paul's, set only by scripts/approve.py through his /approve; 'met' means Approved or Approved with Conditions and the files recorded with THAT approval are unchanged (an edit voids only that decision; later ones are flagged 'upstream change'). CONDITIONS are facts the scripts check themselves and log in log.md the first time they are met; nobody approves them. Each decision names its artifact (the status.json mark listing the files the approval covers) and its producer (the command that writes them).

entity_approved.label: Entity foundation approved (category entity, area entity, variant list, reserved homepage variant)

proof_sheet_approved.label: Client proof sheet approved by Paul, ready for him to send
proof_sheet_approved.plain: the client proof sheet (ready for you to send)

audit_approved.label: Audit deliverables approved (Finding Register, URL Decision Map, Recommendations, Evidence Manifest)

brand_guide_approved.label: Brand Guide approved: the client's returned proof sheet reconciled (verified facts separated from unsupported claims)

discovery_signed_off.label: Discovery and audit signed off — Build may start

blockers_cleared.label: Technical blocker checklist cleared and tracking stable

link_wheel_approved.label: Link wheel built and verified — schema may start

release_approved.label: Schema built and QA cleared — release

blog_map_approved.label: Blog Decision Map approved — redirects and blog briefs may start

blog_topics_approved.label: Blog Authority Builder topic list approved (checked against service and location page FAQs)

client_setup.label: Client set up (/new-client finished)
client_setup.plain: the client has been set up with /new-client

proof_sheet_returned.label: The client returned the proof sheet (the returned sheet is recorded)
proof_sheet_returned.wait_for: the client to return the proof sheet

audit_steps_complete.plain: an outcome for every audit step

pages_built.plain: every page built and written back

safe_fixes_allowed.label: Safe fixes allowed (audit approved): broken links, alt text, image URLs, sitemap, robots.txt, meta description duplicates, speed

structural_changes_allowed.label: Structural changes allowed (entity + Brand Guide approved): redirects, URL/slug changes, consolidations, SEO titles and H1s
structural_changes_allowed.plain: the entity foundation and the reconciled Brand Guide (structural changes)
